name: Holi
owner: Supermercados Holi (founders Eduardo Wong and Theo Lozano)

logoSources.notes: Official logo from holisupermercado.com (site logo / apple-touch-icon / og:image): green 'H' 'L' 'i', orange power-button 'o' with leaf, two green+orange arcs; transparent PNG 2195x1752. Placed on white, scaled to the circle-safe area (the arcs follow the circle). Local copy: tools/seed/logo-src/holi/logo-holi.png.

The official Holi logo exists only as the stacked mark (HōLi with two arcs, aspect ~0.9:1); there is no horizontal wordmark, so there is no -wide.png and the card marker style falls back to the badge (SPEC §3.3: -wide.png is optional). The trimmed stacked copy that was used as the wide logo is kept for reference at tools/seed/logo-src/holi/holi-wide-stacked-unused.png.

notes: Small-format ('supermercado express') omnichannel supermarket chain in Lima, first store 2023 in Surquillo; founders Eduardo Wong (CEO) and Theo Lozano (Peru Retail 2023-02-18, https://www.peru-retail.com/supermercado-holi-planea-abrir-50-locales-en-peru-en-dos-anos-y-alista-su-internacionalizacion/). IDENTIFICATION: the green/orange 'HōLi' logo on the user's Lima Sur slide = this chain (identical to the official logo). Official site: holisupermercado.com (holi.pe is a parked domain). Store count: Gestión 2026-08-03, 'alcanzó las 12 tiendas operativas con la apertura de un nuevo establecimiento en San Miguel'. There is no store list on the site: its 'find your nearest Holi' section is only a Google Maps search embed for 'Holi supermercado' (storeLocator points to that homepage section). Wikidata: Q139603397 (Holi, cadena de supermercados peruana) — NOTE for the scan stage: tools/scan-osm.mjs currently says no QID exists for Holi. Colours from the official logo: green #6FB74C, orange #F08215. OSM (probe 2026-10-01): ~6 features ('Holi Supermercado' x4, 'Holi' x2; shop=supermarket/convenience), none brand-tagged. Regex requires the name to START with 'Holi' as a separate word (excludes 'Holiday', 'Perricholi', 'Cholita', 'Catholic'), and only shop=supermarket/convenience.
